title: fslstats
description: FSL tool for calculating statistics on image data

index_mask.description: Generate separate n submasks from indexMask, for indexvalues 1..n where n is the maximum index value in indexMask, and generate statistics for each submask
index_mask.title: Index mask

robust_intensity_flag.description: Output robust min and max intensity
robust_intensity_flag.title: Robust intensity flag

nonzero_voxels_volume_flag.description: Output voxels and volume (for nonzero voxels)
nonzero_voxels_volume_flag.title: Nonzero voxels and volume flag

smallest_roi_flag.description: Output smallest ROI containing nonzero voxels
smallest_roi_flag.title: Smallest ROI flag

cog_mm_flag.title: Center of gravity in mm flag

cog_voxel_flag.title: Center of gravity in voxel flag

absolute_values_flag.description: Use absolute values of all image intensities
absolute_values_flag.title: Absolute values flag

nan_as_zero_flag.description: Treat NaN or Inf as zero for subsequent stats
nan_as_zero_flag.title: NaN as zero flag

mask_image.description: Use the specified image for masking - overrides lower and upper thresholds
mask_image.title: Mask image

difference_image.description: Take the difference between the base image and the image specified here
difference_image.title: Difference image

hist_bins.description: Output a histogram for the thresholded/masked voxels only with specified number of bins
hist_bins.title: Histogram bins

hist_bins_min_max.description: Output a histogram for the thresholded/masked voxels only with specified number of bins and histogram limits of min and max
hist_bins_min_max.title: Histogram bins with limits

timeseries_flag.description: Separate output line for each 3D volume of a 4D timeseries
timeseries_flag.title: Timeseries flag
